schedule: always-on FastAPI daemon (HTTP on 127.0.0.1:8766) started by the stream watchdog like the pollers
notes: DeepAgent JSON server (python -m llm_agents.deep_agents.server): POST /run {goal, data?, model?, max_steps?, system?, temperature?} runs one THREAD as a LangGraph StateGraph (runner.run_thread, langgraph 1.x): plan node (when the request's data.prompts select llm.ai_prompts prompt_type-2 rows, one LLM call proposes the plan JSON and persists it as pending llm.deep_agent_states rows + llm.deep_agent_contexts payloads), execute node (the DeepAgent tool-calling agent loop over the read-only DB MCP daemon 127.0.0.1:8765/mcp, ticking each plan step via its update_plan_step builtin tool; spawned subagents become child states), finalize node (in_progress -> failed, pending -> skipped) — compiled with AsyncPostgresSaver whose checkpoints (one per superstep, keyed by the thread_id) live in the dedicated langgraph schema (search_path-pinned; schema created SQL-first in database/sql/text/llm/07_deep_agent_states.sql). Execute failures flow as run_error state so finalize settles the thread before the original exception re-raises. Returns {answer, steps, n_tool_calls, model, thread_id?, plan?, stopped?}. POST /stop {thread_id?} cancels the in-flight run(s) (the named thread, or every active one — each /run registers its task under a server-minted thread_id): the cancelled run winds down at its current await (no further LLM spend), runner.settle_thread closes the audit trail (in_progress -> failed 'stopped by user', pending -> skipped) and the pending /run answers {answer: "", stopped: true, thread_id?, plan?} → {stopped, thread_ids}. The data_viz API bridge's transport for POST /api/ai/summary (the analysis-summary generation; the request's data.analysis_items + data.prompts keys ride in the structured context, skills resolved from llm.ai_prompts by the agent itself, plan prompts consumed by the plan node) and POST /api/ai/summary/stop (the UI's hover-to-Stop button). Persistence is fail-soft throughout: a DB outage degrades to a checkpointer-less plain run. One instance only — the registration guard auto-exits a second run. PARALLEL GENERATION (2026-11-01): the daemon is concurrent-safe by design (one MCP session per /run, the shared provider transport is a plain async POSTer), so the analysis-summary generation admits MULTIPLE runs at once — max_parallel_runs (this file) caps how many the data_viz bridge lets through, a generate past the cap is rejected fast (never queued) with a cap-aware message; max_parallel stays the DAEMON PROCESS cap (1 — still one instance). POST /api/ai/summary/stop carries an optional threadId to cancel one run of several; the thread-less form (the UI's Stop button) cancels every active run as before.
